I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

That's from his own post in #central-team on 9 Jun at 10:46. He said the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to PD-4821. I also reminded him of the problem he raised there: the file labels the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs sorting out before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
